name: Sterling Company
description: The Sterling Company is a wealthy, powerful company on Thunder Junction, led by Bertram Graywater, that hires couriers and mercenaries and keeps what passes for law around Prosperity.

timeline.summary: Archie waits for an hour in Omenport until a masked stranger from another plane arrives through the Omenpath and hands him a burlap sack.
timeline.quote: In his outstretched fist was a burlap sack.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Archie sets off across the desert in a carriage with two Sterling guards, expecting bandits.
timeline.quote: His employer would never have provided two Sterling Company guards unless the job carried risks.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A wall of fire stops the carriage and the Hellspurs kill the Sterling guards.
timeline.quote: Nearly a dozen holes appeared across the side of the carriage, and the Sterling guards fell immediately.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Disguised as a courier, Oko enters Sterling Company headquarters carrying a box with Tinybones inside.
timeline.quote: The moment he stepped over the threshold, Oko surveyed the room.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Sterling guards, Oko is saved when Kellan throws the guards back with golden vine-shaped magic.
timeline.quote: Confusion swirled through Oko's mind until he realized the magic was coming from Kellan.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie names an Outcaster named Nolan who can read the artifact, and Vraska says he is on a train to Prosperity under Sterling guard.
timeline.quote: "The man in question is currently on a train to Prosperity, escorted by Sterling mercenaries."

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Gisa raises zombies too early, and Sterling guards find Kellan, Oko and Umezawa in the luggage car.
timeline.quote: "She raised the zombies too early," Geralf groaned.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A fight in the luggage car leaves Umezawa wounded and two guards down.
timeline.quote: Oko moved swiftly, freeing a curved knife from his belt.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Oko cross the train roof, are attacked by Sterling guards, and are saved by Gisa's reanimated dead.
timeline.quote: Gray rotted arms closed around the guard's shoulders, and her weapon clattered to the ground.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko disguises himself as a guard to lure away Nolan's escorts, and he and Kellan toss them off the train, capturing Nolan.
timeline.quote: give Graywater my regards.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Oko abandons Kellan as he struggles to hold the train at the cliff edge as the Sterling army approaches.
timeline.quote: With a final glance, he turned his back on Kellan and fled for the hills.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie returns and holds off the Sterling riders while the passengers jump from the train.
timeline.quote: each of them nervously jumping for the desert floor before fleeing as far from the train as possible.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: The Sterling Company army led by Ral Zarek attacks Tarnation, interrupting the duel.
timeline.quote: The Sterling Company had found Tarnation—and they had brought an army.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: A Sterling guard knocks Kellan out as Oko leaves him behind.
timeline.quote: instead, Oko turned for the road and left his son behind.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan wakes in a Sterling prison carriage, realizing Oko left him behind.
timeline.quote: The truth stung more than any wound: Oko had left him behind.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek knocks out the guards and frees Kellan from the carriage.
timeline.quote: He leaned forward and unlocked the cuffs from Kellan's wrists

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 5: High Moon" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Sterling Company expands its territory again.
timeline.quote: Sterling Company Expands Territory Again

citation.text: Overwhelming Forces (Breaking News, 2024), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Akul's gang kills courier Archie Dixon and two guards seeking the final key piece, which is not there.
timeline.quote: killing a courier named Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sterling mercenaries attack Tarnation and Oko steals the key.
timeline.quote: it was stolen by Oko

citation.text: "Akul", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Annie and Eriette break Kaervek and Satoru Umezawa out of the Sterling Company's cells.
timeline.quote: As they broke the ancient warlock and the ninja free from their cells

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko kidnaps the scholar Nolan from a guarded train while Annie and Kellan save civilians before it crashes.
timeline.quote: Oko decided to kidnap him from the train he was riding into town on

citation.text: "Annie Flash", section "Working with Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Thunder Junction, Oko recruits Kaervek for a heist on Maag Taranau; he is imprisoned by the Sterling Company and broken out by Eriette and Annie Flash.
timeline.quote: Eriette and Annie Flash broke them out

citation.text: "Kaervek", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kellan recognizes his father Oko on the road to Prosperity, disrupting Oko's shapeshifting and forcing him to flee the Sterling Company.
timeline.quote: crossed paths with someone whom Kellan immediately recognized as his father

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sterling mercenaries led by Ral, tipped off by Oko, interrupt the duel; Oko steals the vault key and Kellan is knocked out.
timeline.quote: he saw his father regarding him with indifference as he left for the vault

citation.text: "Kellan", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko and the crew steal a vault key from Bertram Graywater's office.
timeline.quote: they secured the key

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko plans to infiltrate Tarnation, secretly arranging for his team to be captured and the Sterling Company raid.
timeline.quote: he submitted an anonymous tip about Tarnation's location to the Sterling Company so they would raid the city

citation.text: "Oko", section "Thunder Junction heist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Satoru and Kaervek are imprisoned by the Sterling Company.
timeline.quote: Later, they were both imprisoned by the Sterling Company

citation.text: "Satoru Umezawa", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Omenpaths open, the plane is overrun with outlaws, Riveteers build railroads, Ral Zarek builds relay towers, and the Sterling Company keeps peace.
timeline.quote: After the opening of the Omenpaths, Thunder Junction was overrun with outlaws

citation.text: "Thunder Junction", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Omenpaths open, parties race for the Vault; Akul builds Tarnation, and Graywater collects keys.
timeline.quote: Akul and the Hellspurs built Tarnation around the vault hoping to control it.

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Akul takes the key from the gang and fits it to his medallion, revealing six pieces of one key; Oko steals it back.
timeline.quote: Oko stole this final key back during a shootout

citation.text: "Maag Taranau", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral Zarek and Niv-Mizzet test a relay tower on Thunder Junction.
timeline.quote: it became the test site of Ral Zarek and Niv-Mizzet's relay tower project to develop a way to communicate through the Omenpaths.

citation.text: "Omenpath", section "Thunder Junction colonization". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 4564 AR Akul's gang attacks a carriage transport, killing the courier Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards to get the last key piece.
timeline.quote: killing a courier named Archie Dixon and two Sterling Company guards

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sterling mercenaries tipped off by Oko attack Tarnation, Oko steals the key and the Hellspurs are defeated.
timeline.quote: The Hellspurs were ultimately defeated by the Sterling mercenaries.

citation.text: "Hellspurs", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko's crew stages a train heist, battles the guards, and captures Nolan; Nolan jumps from the train with Annie and Fortune's help.
timeline.quote: Oko's crew staged a train heist

citation.text: "Nolan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko's gang steals the final key piece from Bertram Graywater.
timeline.quote: Bertram Graywater of the Sterling Company held the final piece until Oko’s gang stole it.

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko steals the key back during a Sterling-Hellspur shootout.
timeline.quote: Oko stole it back during a Sterling–Hellspur shootout

citation.text: "The Vault Heist", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tinybones and Oko raid the Sterling Company headquarters and obtain a vault key, but Oko's illusion fails at the sight of Kellan.
timeline.quote: The plan succeeded in obtaining the key

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko wears Tinybones as bone armor to be captured on purpose; Tinybones undoes his chains and they make a break for Maag Taranau.
timeline.quote: Tinybones undid his chains, and along with Oko made a break for Maag Taranau.

citation.text: "Tinybones", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
